# Contract: design-to-code-inspection

SumitCraft addition. Category: design. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Compare an implemented page with a written spec or reference at several widths and report measured mismatches.

## Use it for
- "does my build match the design"
- "responsive check against the spec"

## Not for
- is this design good (design-critique)

## Accepted inputs
A page (file or local URL) and spec.json; optional reference screenshots.

## Deliverables
report.md/json, screenshots per width.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Opens only the page given.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Get the reference
2. Write spec.json
3. Run it:
4. Look at the shots
5. Fix and re-run

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Sort mismatches: bug, spec error, acceptable

## Quality checks
- Fails on the planted fixture, passes on the fixed one

## Common failures
- Cross-platform font rendering differences in pixel diffs

## Limitations
- Measures; does not judge taste

## Reproducible example
examples/pricing-card (10 mismatches vs 0).
